judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the planning/acceptance-test phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. Because the production bug was not fixed, the newly added test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Additionally, the candidate completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the working tree. While the spec update in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the test logic itself closely match the reference design, the core implementation and changelog entries are missing.
